rail.subtitle: YouTube audio and video
banner.update: A new version of {app} is available: {version}
format.mp3: The most compatible: works on any player, car or phone.
format.m4a: Very compatible, with better quality than MP3 at the same size. YouTube already provides it this way, with no re-encoding.
format.opus: YouTube's original audio: the best quality for its size. Some older players can't open it.
format.flac: Lossless when saved, but YouTube has no lossless audio: it doesn't sound better, it just takes more space.
format.wav: Uncompressed, useful for audio editing. Files are very large.
format.mkv: Keeps the original quality without converting. It might not play on some devices.
playlist.empty: The playlist is empty or private
audio.title: Download audio
audio.subtitle: A YouTube link or the name of a song to search for.
video.title: Download video
video.subtitle: Check a link to see the qualities available for the video.
video.empty: The available qualities will show up here after checking a link.
video.need_https: The link must start with https://
video.resolution_note: Only the qualities available for this video are shown. Sizes are approximate.
video.codec_warning: At 1440p and 4K the video comes in a newer format that might not play on some older devices. 1080p or lower offers wider compatibility.
queue.empty: No downloads. Add them from Audio or Video.
queue.resume_note: If Onitune is closed before they finish, downloads continue on their own when it's opened again.
history.title: History
history.file_gone: The file is no longer there
history.delete_file: Also delete the file from disk

history.clear_text.one: 1 download will be removed from the history. Files stay in their folder unless the box is checked.
history.clear_text.other: {n} downloads will be removed from the history. Files stay in their folder unless the box is checked.

history.clear_files.one: Also delete the files from disk (1 file)
history.clear_files.other: Also delete the files from disk ({n} files)

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes are saved automatically.
settings.language_note: Missing a language? Adding one is easy: just translate one file. The instructions are on GitHub.
settings.playlist_subfolder: Save each playlist in its own subfolder
settings.cookies_note: They're needed for age-restricted, private or members-only videos. The app uses the browser's YouTube session (you must be signed in on youtube.com), without asking for your password. Onitune doesn't keep copies of the cookies.
settings.cookies_file_help: To create a cookies.txt: install a browser extension that exports cookies (for example, "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY"), open youtube.com while signed in and export them. Keep the file somewhere private: it gives access to your account.
settings.cookies_ok_browser: They work: {count} cookies were read from {browser}.
settings.cookies_ok_file: It works: yt-dlp could use the file.
settings.cookies_empty: No cookies were found in that browser.
settings.cookies_test_none: First choose where to get the cookies from.
settings.cookies_file_missing: The chosen cookies file wasn't found.
settings.search_note: When searching in the Audio tab, only songs on YouTube Music are searched. They come with the right artist, album and cover, but the search takes a few more seconds. When off, it searches regular YouTube (including music videos, live versions, lyric videos…).
settings.cover_note: YouTube stores thumbnails as rectangles and pads the sides of album covers. Cropping keeps only the center square, like YouTube Music does. If the original image is rectangular, its side edges are lost.
settings.cover_music: Only YouTube Music songs (search or music.youtube.com links)
settings.cover_none: Never (keep the thumbnail as it is)
settings.app_updates: Let me know when there's a new version of Onitune
settings.about_ai: The code was written with the help of artificial intelligence (Claude, by Anthropic).
settings.about_license: Free software under the MIT license. Uses yt-dlp, FFmpeg, Deno and pywebview; their licenses are in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
settings.about_disclaimer: {app} is not affiliated with YouTube or Google. Only download content you have the right to keep.
setup.title: Getting Onitune ready
setup.subtitle: First-time setup of the app. It only happens once.
setup.update_subtitle: This version needs a new component. It's downloaded only once.
setup.done_summary: Downloaded: {list}. Each file was checked against its SHA256 security checksum: it arrived complete and unmodified.
setup.ytdlp_desc: The program that talks to YouTube.
setup.ffmpeg_desc: Converts the audio and joins the video with the sound.
setup.folders: Create the Audio and Video folders
setup.note: They are saved inside the app's folder ({path}). Nothing needs to be installed and no administrator rights are needed.
setup.error: Couldn't finish: {error}. Check the internet connection.
setup.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg wasn't found inside the downloaded package.
setup.deno_desc: JavaScript engine that yt-dlp needs to read YouTube.
setup.no_deno: Deno wasn't found inside the downloaded package.
setup.no_hash: The security checksum for {name} wasn't found.
setup.bad_hash: {name} was downloaded damaged or modified (its checksum doesn't match)
error.live: It's a live stream: it can't be downloaded while it's on air
error.age: Age-restricted video: cookies are needed (see Settings)
error.bot: YouTube is asking to sign in: cookies are needed (see Settings)
error.private: Private video: cookies from an account with access are needed (see Settings)
error.members: Members-only video: cookies are needed (see Settings)
error.offline: No internet connection or YouTube isn't responding
error.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg is missing: it's installed when the app is opened again
error.bad_answer: yt-dlp returned a response that can't be understood
error.folder: Couldn't use the folder {folder}. Is the drive connected?
error.cookies_blocked: Chrome and Edge don't allow reading their cookies on Windows. Use another browser (Firefox, Brave…) or a cookies.txt file (see Settings)
error.cookies_locked: The browser is open and locks its cookies. Close it completely and try again
error.cookies_not_found: The chosen browser's cookies weren't found: is it installed and has it been opened at least once?
error.cookies_bad_file: The cookies file can't be used: it must be a cookies.txt in Netscape format
error.cookies_expired: The YouTube cookies expired: sign in again on youtube.com (and export a new cookies.txt if you use a file)
deps.system: Installed on the system: Onitune doesn't update it
